title: Algorithm: Currency Exchange Converter Function
subtitle: Financial Engineering Routine
description: Build currency exchange helpers across 2 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Default Exchange Rate
challenges.description: Call <hlt>convert_usd_to_inr(10)</hlt> using default rate (83.0) and print result.
challenges.starter_code:
def convert_usd_to_inr(usd, rate=83.0):
    return usd * rate

# Stage 1: Default rate (83.0)
print(convert_usd_to_inr(10))

challenges.title: Stage 2: Custom Spot Rate
challenges.description: Call <hlt>convert_usd_to_inr(50, 83.5)</hlt> with custom market rate and print result.
challenges.starter_code:
def convert_usd_to_inr(usd, rate=83.0):
    return usd * rate

# Stage 2: Custom market rate (83.5)
print(convert_usd_to_inr(50, 83.5))
